span.p:
mando_localization 상세 데이터·알고리즘 계약
현재 YAML 기본값 기준 · ENU · 2D · 단위 m, m/s, rad

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/molit/sensors/imu/data
sensor_msgs/Imu · imu_link
age ≤ 0.25 s · future ≤ 0.05 s
quaternion 오차 ≤ 0.001
raw covariance=0 관측 · measured override 활성

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Arduino → /erp42_serial/feedback · 약 10 Hz
erp42_msgs/SerialFeedBack · Header 없음
uint8: MorA, EStop, Gear, alive
float64: speed[m/s], steer[ADC]
int16: brake · int32: encoder[최근 0.10 s delta]

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ImuNormalizer
timestamp·frame·finite·quaternion 검사
override stddev²로 양의 covariance 생성
→ /mando_localization/internal/ekf/imu

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EncoderToTwistAdapter
finite(speed,steer) · |speed| ≤ 30 m/s
|encoder| ≤ 100000 · steer 0–65535 ADC
alive가 직전 값과 같으면 거부 · uint8 wrap 허용
vx = speed × speed_scale 1.0 × direction_sign 1
stamp=PC receipt time · frame=base_link
Var(vx)=0.25 (m/s)² · 나머지 축=1000000
공개: /molit/vehicle/twist
내부: /mando_localization/internal/ekf/twist

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local EKF · robot_localization/ekf_localization_node
30 Hz · sensor_timeout 0.15 s · two_d_mode=true
관측: IMU yaw, vyaw + Twist vx
rejection threshold: 각 입력 5.0
Q diag 핵심: x/y=0.05, yaw=0.03, vx=0.20, vyaw=0.08
출력: /molit/localization/local/odometry
TF 유일 소유: odom → base_link

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/molit/sensors/gps/fix
sensor_msgs/NavSatFix · gps_link
fix status ≥ 0 · age ≤ 1.0 s
horizontal variance ≤ 25 m²
vertical variance ≤ 100 m²

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OdometryGpsFusion
datum 주변 WGS84 local tangent 근사
east=N·cos(lat₀)·Δlon
north=M·Δlat
z=map_z + altitude-altitude₀
yaw_offset 회전 + map xyz offset
현재 mode=first_fix · measured=false

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GPS Gate
quality-only candidate를 내부 토픽으로 먼저 발행
Local Odom 증분으로 map 위치 예측
연속 후보 간 거리 ≤ 50 m
Euclidean innovation ≤ 10 m
sqrt(innovationᵀ S⁻¹ innovation) ≤ 5.0
초기·짧은 복구 후보 3회 연속 승인

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/molit/sensors/lidar/scan
sensor_msgs/LaserScan · laser_link
age ≤ 0.30 s · range 수 ≥ 20
finite 비율 ≥ 0.50

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
scan 검사 후 /mando_localization/internal/amcl/scan relay
AMCL likelihood_field
beam=60 · range 0.05–30 m
particles 500–3000 · KLD err=0.05, z=0.99
update: 0.10 m 또는 0.10 rad
tf_broadcast=false

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AMCL pose: age ≤ 0.50 s
position variance ≤ 4.0 m²
yaw variance ≤ 0.2741556778 rad²
즉시 허용: jump ≤ 3.0 m, ≤ 0.7853981634 rad
복구 후보: 반경 ≤ 1.0 m, yaw ≤ 0.35 rad, 3회 연속
→ /molit/localization/lidar/map_pose
PoseWithCovarianceStamped

div.style: color: rgb(16, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/map · nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid
map_server → /mando_localization/internal/amcl/map
현재 실제 map.yaml 없음

div.style: color: rgb(61, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Global EKF · robot_localization/ekf_localization_node
30 Hz · sensor_timeout 0.20 s · two_d_mode=true
예측: IMU yaw,vyaw + Twist vx
보정: GPS x,y + LiDAR x,y,yaw
모든 입력 rejection threshold=5.0
Local Odom은 상관 중복 때문에 직접 융합하지 않음
Q diag 핵심: x/y=0.20, yaw=0.05, vx=0.25, vyaw=0.10
출력: /molit/localization/global/odometry
TF 유일 소유: map → odom

div.style: color: rgb(18, 53, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RelocalizationCoordinator
이전 anchor + 긴 단절 > 2.0 s
candidate age ≤ 1.0 s · future ≤ 0.10 s
첫 GPS 기준 ≤ 2 m · 증가 GPS stamp만 count
LiDAR fresh + pair skew ≤ 0.20 s
각 GPS↔LiDAR ≤ 5 m · GPS 후보 3회 연속
LiDAR stamp 독립성·EKF 수용 ACK는 미확인
LiDAR pair 불가: 정지 ≤ 0.30 m/s + 후보 5회
measured flag + Global XY 2 m 안 3회
GPS-only 자동 reset 기본 false

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationStatusManager
fresh timeout: IMU/Encoder/Local/Global=0.20 s
GPS=1.00 s · LiDAR=0.50 s
GPS↔LiDAR ≤ 5 m · absolute↔Global ≤ 10 m
DR 한계: 2.0 s 또는 10 m 중 먼저 초과
→ 내부 evaluated status / state / valid

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationSupervisor
StatusManager 평가 + recovery heartbeat 중재
evaluation/recovery age ≤ 0.50 s
누락·stale → FAULT · active → RELOCALIZING
공개 /state, /valid, /status 단일 소유

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/molit/localization/recovery/state
VALIDATING · WAITING · BLOCKED
TIMEOUT · RECOVERED telemetry

div.style: color: rgb(75, 17, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationOutputGate
valid age ≤ 0.50 s + Global Odom age ≤ 0.20 s
future stamp ≤ 0.05 s · frame map/base_link
finite·quaternion·PSD covariance 재검사
invalid 시 마지막 pose 재발행=false
통과한 메시지만 /molit/localization/odometry

div.style: color: rgb(38, 23, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LocalizationVisualization · 10 Hz
/molit/localization/path: 최대 2000 poses
0.05 m 또는 0.02 rad 변화 시 추가
invalid 시 Path 삭제
/molit/localization/markers + RViz panel 5 Hz

div.style: color: rgb(90, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
운영 전 차단 조건
Arduino Header 없음 → transport/source 지연 미관측
encoder meter-per-tick·steer ADC=unmeasured/비활성
IMU covariance=정지 noise measured, 운영 verified 아님
GPS datum=first_fix/unmeasured
LiDAR localization=false + 실제 map 없음
센서 정적 TF Y/Z/RPY 미측정 → 정확도 검증 전
